microservices.name: customer-service
microservices.description: Manages customer information, validation, and management.

microservices.name: order-service
microservices.description: Handles order creation, modification, tracking, and association with customers.

microservices.name: shipment-service
microservices.description: Manages shipment creation, tracking, and coordination with order fulfillment.

microservices.name: authentication-service
microservices.description: Handles user registration, login, password management, and two-factor authentication.

patterns.explanation: Each microservice has its own private database to ensure loose coupling and independent scaling.
API gateway aggregates requests and coordinates calls to multiple services for cross‑cutting concerns.
Separate command and query layers enable optimized data access for write and read operations.
Handles distributed transactions across services by executing local updates and compensating transactions on failure.
Replicates data from provider services into a read‑only cache to reduce latency and database load.
Stores state changes as immutable events, enabling auditability and supporting CQRS query patterns.

datastores.description: Persists customer profiles, validation rules, and history. Driven by user stories US-CUSTOMER-CRUD.
Stores order details, line items, and status. Driven by US-ORDER-CREATE … US-ORDER-LIST.
Stores shipment information, tracking numbers, and carrier data. Driven by US-SHIPMENT-CREATE ….
Stores user credentials, JWT tokens, and password policies. Driven by US-AUTH-REGISTER … US-AUTH-FORGOTT-PASS.

dependencies.description: API gateway forwards requests to the appropriate service and aggregates responses.
Routes API gateway requests to order service.
Customer service retrieves order details for a customer.
Order service initiates shipment creation linked to an order.
Publishes shipment events for customer notification.
Order service queries customer data before creating an order.
Shipment service notifies order service of status changes.
